method: read-only function-level source comparison; statuses are not whole-platform certification

entries.evidence: NASA engine time advances with rate; ours advances elapsed_seconds*rate. Negative rates supported; host owns per-RAF advance.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Wall-time discontinuity and coverage reload must not reset accumulated clock on rate-only changes.

entries.evidence: Current play preserves lastFrame for rate-only changes and resets only playing transition; prior rate-change regression was repaired. Busy+playing still rejects; pause remains allowed.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Review current simultaneous coverage loading separately.

entries.evidence: NASA predicts next-frame crossing and routes to boundary interior +/-1ms with rate0/message; ours rolls back lastPublishedEpoch and reloads target coverage, preserving desiredPlaying when possible.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: End-of-mission behavior, reverse boundaries and error messages are not identical.

entries.evidence: NASA isNow rate1 and UTC error<1000ms; ours exposes live logic plus authoritative TDB conversion.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Not a full leap-second scientific certification.

entries.evidence: Our Rust explicit UTC/TDB implementation is distinct from recovered NASA TimeUtils; unit/frame intent explicit.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Compare numerical golden epochs across leap-second boundaries before exact equivalence.

entries.evidence: Existing source golden table and 101 rates tests; preserves signed reverse rates and real-rate formatting.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Complete pointer/touch behavioral equivalence still requires actual UI comparison.

entries.evidence: Our route intentionally stores TDB semantic state, validates finite rates and target IDs; dates pass controlled Rust conversion.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Exact NASA URL syntax and complete camera-angle route state are different.

entries.evidence: Type-specific strict decoder, indexed fetch and source coverage checks replace NASA mutable download classes.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Unsupported formats must remain explicit; no extrapolated ready state.

entries.evidence: Our orb interpolates propagated endpoint positions and endpoint velocities, and barycenter scales by mu1/mu2.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Interpolated state is not the same as propagating interpolated elements; preserve this distinction.

entries.evidence: Lin interpolates positions; pos uses cubic Hermite position+velocity; strict source coverage.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Pos/lin currently linear-search sample index, potential large-source frame cost.

entries.evidence: Projects endpoint orientation with angular velocity, shortest-arc quaternion interpolation then normalization.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Sample lookup is linear scan; huge ori payloads can add per-frame cost; no measured freeze conclusion.

entries.evidence: ORI unavailable outside known coverage now permits preceding declared align result; transient transport failures are distinguished. Controller array order is preserved.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: ORI precedence and outside coverage must remain coupled to actual source coverage; never silently turn failure into measured attitude.

entries.evidence: Source point/velocity/align axes are applied in declared controller order; dependencies fetched before solve.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Unimplemented axis/controller types and reference-only frames must surface errors rather than invented orientation.

entries.evidence: NASA first same-class controller runs all exits before any enters/updates and throttles callbacks using Date.now. Our filters choose active declarations but do not implement callback lifecycle. Captured definitions contain 41 coverage controllers (JWST,Clementine,GRACE,etc).
entries.crossFeatureRisk: P1: visibility/model deployment and mission-phase callbacks can differ even with correct DYN positions. Recover and explicitly implement whitelisted callbacks; never eval captured expressions.

entries.evidence: parentAt follows time-ordered boundaries; current state applies historical parent recursively; current source loading is keyed by data parent.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Do not reuse a DYN payload from another parent phase based only on overlapping time coverage.

entries.evidence: NASA intersects configured/automatic interval with entity position coverage; ours uses current phase fallback plus optional independently prepared historical segments.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: History currently selected-target only and finite 32-segment/record budgets; fallback remains shorter when preparation unavailable.

entries.evidence: NASA orb branch uses interpolated eccentricity, mu1+mu2 and h: E=-mu^2(1-e^2)/(2h^2), duration=2pi*mu/sqrt(8*abs(min(1,E^3))). Ours orb uses current record 2pi/abs(meanAngularMotion); nonorb uses finite-difference 2pi*h/v^2.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: P1 for strict matching: interpolated elements, hyperbolic/near-parabolic and blended source states need numerical golden cases; circular consistent data alone does not establish equivalence.

entries.evidence: Independent historical evaluator composes historical body parent into world then subtracts same-time current reference body. Main data/clock never restored through checkpoint.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Explicit relativeToEntity and relativeToEntityOrientation options are not fully represented by current SDK history style.

entries.ours: platform/solar-system.ts prepareTrailHistory existing cache gate and trailSamples history gate
entries.evidence: Both history reuse gates require epoch>=history.epoch, despite prepared interval covering earlier samples. In reverse playback each refresh discards valid cached history and creates sources again.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: P1 performance: use actual prepared start/end and safe refresh margin in both directions, test reverse ticks do not repeat network preparation inside existing window.

entries.evidence: Bounded caches, abort and disposal isolate late histories from current source publication. checkpoint restore cancels loads and is not used for history.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Prepared source counts and record totals must remain global-budgeted across historical chunks.

entries.evidence: This recovered file is a UI BaseComponent despite its engine/controllers directory; rate changes route to TimeManager, using fixed 365-day years/30-day months. Our host routes controlled time intents and retains saved rate separately from playing.
entries.crossFeatureRisk: Do not mistake this UI component for an unimplemented generic mission callback controller. Older compact +/- rates and new TimeControls 101-map are separate NASA surfaces.
